evals.prompt: I want to turn our release-notes workflow into a Claude Code skill and test it on a few real prompts against a baseline before I trust it.
evals.expected_output: Load claude-skill-creator, capture the intent, draft the skill, propose two or three realistic test prompts, and ask for approval of the paid with-skill and baseline runs before starting them.
assertions: The response proposes realistic test prompts for the skill.
The response asks for approval before starting paid model runs.

evals.prompt: Tighten the wording of our AGENTS.md so the completion criteria are clearer. I will paste it next.
evals.expected_output: Do not load claude-skill-creator: editing an agent instruction file without test runs belongs to writing-for-agents.

evals.prompt: My review-report skill rarely triggers. Optimize its description with a trigger eval set and measure the hit rate before and after.
evals.expected_output: Load claude-skill-creator for description optimization, plan a realistic should-trigger and should-not-trigger query set for the user to review, and ask before running the paid claude -p loop.
assertions: The response includes near-miss should-not-trigger queries in the plan.
The response asks for approval before running the optimization loop.
